name: Slow Burn
text: Share unhurried kisses, taking breaks whenever either of you wants.

name: Closer
text: Sit comfortably together and share kisses or a cuddle.

name: Whisper
text: Whisper a romantic idea you would enjoy sharing later. It is an invitation, not an obligation.

name: Massage Break
text: Offer a gentle shoulder or upper-back massage.

name: Eyes Closed
text: If welcomed, offer gentle kisses on agreed places such as the cheek, forehead, or hand.

name: Five Favorites
text: The receiver chooses five places such as the forehead, cheeks, hands, or shoulders for a gentle kiss.

name: Your Wish
text: The receiver chooses a kiss, cuddle, or shoulder massage.

name: Warm Welcome
text: Wrap yourselves in a cozy blanket and share an embrace.

name: Hold My Gaze
text: Hold hands and each say one thing you appreciate about the other.

name: Tell Me
text: Describe a favorite romantic memory and what made it meaningful.

name: Guided Comfort
text: Offer a hand or shoulder massage with pressure guided by the receiver.

name: Gentle Touch
text: Offer gentle touches on hands, arms, or shoulders, checking what feels welcome.

name: Take the Lead
text: Offer a mutually agreed sequence of kisses, cuddles, or dancing. Either person can change the plan.

name: Show Me
text: Demonstrate a hand massage and let your partner try.

name: Name It
text: Ask what helps your partner feel loved. They may answer, choose another question, or pass.

name: Shared Pause
text: Put the device aside and enjoy a quiet embrace.

name: Mirror
text: Take turns offering and mirroring a hand squeeze, forehead kiss, or hug.

name: Welcome Back
text: Re-create a romantic greeting with a compliment and a kiss if welcomed.

name: Date Invitation
text: Suggest a comfortable outfit or a theme for a future date. Your partner may change or decline it.

name: Invitation
text: Offer an idea for a romantic moment later, without a promise or debt.

name: Dance
text: Share a private slow dance to a song you both enjoy.

name: Say It
text: Name three things you find attractive about your partner, including a quality beyond appearance.

name: Encore
text: Repeat a previously enjoyed kiss, cuddle, dance, or massage if both want to.

name: Thirty-Second Kiss
text: Offer an unhurried kiss for up to thirty seconds, stopping sooner whenever either person wants.
